answer: Reputation Canyon Decay. New agents start in a shallow canyon of visible score; each attested action moves them toward a delta of trusted history, and benefits unlock only past a threshold. Cloned identities can copy actions but not the time-weighted lagoon of accumulated attestations, since scores decay on inactivity. An attacker pays full onboarding compute plus attestation latency per clone, while each clone yields zero reward until it independently clears the threshold—so marginal clones are strictly negative-EV.
